children: BNB’s price rebound has brought it back to the level where the summer rally started to run into heavy supply. The token is around $731, after climbing sharply from its late-August base and briefly trading near $770 earlier this month. The recovery has therefore reached a straightforward test: buyers need to take back the $750 area and challenge the recent high. Until that happens, the rally remains a recovery inside a broader range rather than a confirmed continuation move.
BNB Chain Activity Strengthens The Bull Case

The latest BNB Chain data offers a mixed but important read. DeFi TVL has reached approximately $5.66 billion, up 15.6% over 30 days. At the same time, 24-hour DEX volume stands near $2.25 billion, up 65.5% against the prior seven-day benchmark. Network fees have also increased sharply, reaching about $4.55 million over 24 hours, while revenue rose to roughly $1.69 million.

Recent data has identified BNB Chain among the leading networks for tokenized stock activity, adding another source of transaction demand beyond traditional DeFi. The chain’s DEX market share has also remained significant. Data for early September put BNB Chain at roughly 14% of total on-chain DEX volume, despite fluctuations in absolute trading volume.
BNB Price Analysis: $750 Is the Gate to $800

BNB price recently broke out of a multi-month base after spending much of the summer between roughly $560 and $625. The move above that range accelerated through $700 before reaching the $750–$770 supply zone. BNB is now trading around $731, putting it directly beneath that resistance. A daily close above $750 would put buyers back in control of the short-term structure, while a move through approximately $770 would confirm that the recent supply has been absorbed. That would bring $800 into focus as the next major psychological target.

The downside is equally defined. A sustained failure around the upper resistance band could send BNB back toward $720, with $700 becoming the more important structural support. A break beneath that area would weaken the breakout and expose the $680–$690 region.

BNB’s setup has shifted from a prolonged consolidation to a more decisive test of buyer strength. The recent breakout has improved the broader structure, but confirmation will depend on whether demand can sustain the move rather than fade after the initial surge. With momentum still constructive, the bias remains cautiously bullish, while a loss of the breakout structure would weaken that view. For now, BNB is at an important inflection point, with the next sustained move likely to determine whether this rally develops into a broader trend.

title: BNB Price Faces $750 Test After Sharp Rebound: Can Bulls Push Higher?
